ज्ञा (ग) जानाति जानीते 9.
c. To know.
With अनु to assent to, acknow-
ledge; with अप to conceal; with
अव to despise; with आ to com-
mand; with प्र to know well;
with उप to deny knowing;
with परि to ascertain; with प्रति
or सं to assent to, promise;
with वि to discriminate; with
सं to recollect; with प्रति and
अभि to recognize. 10th. With आ
to command; with other prepo-
sitions to whet; to praise; slay.

ज्ञप् ज्ञापयति 10.
a. To know; cause
to know; to whet; beat, please.

ज्ञपित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Taught, made
known, expounded.

ज्ञप्त (प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
a. Made known.

ज्ञप्ति (प्तिः) 2.
f. Understanding.

ज्ञाप्ति (प्तिः) 2.
f. Idem.

ज्ञात (तः-ता-तं)
a. Known.

ज्ञात-सिद्वान्त (न्तः) 1.
m. A man well
versed in any science.

ज्ञाता_न्वय (यः) 1.
m. Name of the
last
Jaina pontiff.

ज्ञातव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. Knowable.

ज्ञाति (तिः) 2.
m. A father; a kins-
man; a distant kinsman.

ज्ञाति-कर्म्मन् (र्म्म) 5.
n. Relative duty.

ज्ञातित्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Relationship.

ज्ञातृ (ता-त्री-तृ)
a. Knowing.

ज्ञातेय (यं) 1.
n. Relationship.

ज्ञान (नं) 1.
n. Knowledge in general.

ज्ञान-गम्य (म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
a. Knowable.

ज्ञान-चक्षुस् (क्षुः) 5.
n. Intellectual
vision, intellect.

ज्ञान-तपस् (पः) 5.
n. Search after
sacred knowledge.

ज्ञान-तस्
adv. By knowledge.

ज्ञान-दर्पण (णः) 1.
m. A
Jaina sage;
a mirror of wisdom.

ज्ञान-दीप (पः) 1.
m. Lamp of know-
ledge, knowledge.

ज्ञान-निष्ठ (ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
p. Intent on the
acquisition of knowledge.

ज्ञान-पर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Versed in
knowledge or true wisdom.

ज्ञान-पूर्व्व (र्व्व-र्व्वी-र्व्वं)
a. Preceded by
the acquirement of knowledge.

ज्ञानमय (यः-यी-यं)
a. Consisting of
or full of knowledge.

ज्ञान-मुद्र (द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
a. Having the
impress of wisdom, wise; mak-
ing wise, imparting wisdom.

ज्ञान-मूल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Founded in
knowledge, or true wisdom.

ज्ञान-वत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Wise.

ज्ञान-विज्ञान (नं) 1.
n. Sacred and
profane knowledge.

ज्ञाना_नुत्पाद (दः) 1.
m. Ignorance.

ज्ञाना_वस्थित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Occupied
in the acquisition of wisdom.

ज्ञानिन् (नी-निनी-नि)
a. Wise.
m.
An astrologer; a sage.

ज्ञाने_न्द्रिय (यं) 1.
n. Organ of percep-
tion, as the eye, ear, &c.

ज्ञापक (कः-का-कं)
a. Making known.
m. An instructor; a commander.

ज्ञापन (नं) 1.
n. Making known.

ज्ञान-तत्त्व (त्त्वः-त्त्वा-त्त्वं)
a. Knowing
God.

ज्ञान-दुर्व्वल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Ignorant, weak.
